disorder-name.detail: FDOPA_01 first episode psychosis patients (ICD-10 psychotic disorder).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_01 dataset included FEP patients who were recruited if they had a diagnosis of psychotic disorder according to ICD 10 criteria"

age.detail: Age reported at FDOPA_01 dataset level (patients+controls); patient-only age not separated in the table.

sex.detail: Sex counts reported at FDOPA_01 dataset level (patients+controls); patient-only sex not separated in the table.

disorder-name.detail: FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 schizophrenia cohorts (DSM-IV SCZ; FDOPA_03 paranoid subtype).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_02 dataset included patients with a DSM-IV diagnosis of SCZ [45]. Patients in the FDOPA_03 dataset were also patients who met the DSM-IV criteria for SCZ, paranoid subtype."

dataset-of-origin.detail: FDOPA_02 (Imaging Site: South Korea) and FDOPA_03 (Imaging Site: MRC Cyclotron Unit).

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD across FDOPA_02 (29.00 [8.70], N=24) and FDOPA_03 (44.52 [9.97], N=24). Demographics reported at dataset level (patients+controls).

sex.detail: Summed dataset-level sex counts from FDOPA_02 (17F/33M) and FDOPA_03 (21F/13M); counts reported for datasets overall (patients+controls).

disorder-name.detail: FDOPA_04 schizophrenia or schizophreniform disorders (mixed FEP + chronic).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "the FDOPA_04 dataset included patients who met the DSM-V criteria for SCZ or schizophreniform disorders"

age.detail: Age reported for FDOPA_04 dataset (patients only).

sex.detail: Sex counts reported for FDOPA_04 dataset (patients only).
